title: Evaluate a numeric expression string
prompt: In evaluate.js, implement the exported function evaluate(expr) that evaluates a string arithmetic expression containing non-negative integers, +, -, *, /, parentheses, and spaces, respecting standard operator precedence (* and / bind tighter than + and -) and parentheses for grouping. Division should be regular (floating point) division. Examples: evaluate("2 + 3 * 4") === 14, evaluate("(2 + 3) * 4") === 20. Do not change test.js.
